description: A jovial British gentleman in his sixties, warm rounded voice, received pronunciation, genial and a little pompous, delighted with everyone, ceremonious, brisk cheerful pacing.
text: Miss Frost, allow me — Sir William Lucas — and I shall introduce you to everyone of consequence! Even Mr Darcy, who has danced at St James's itself, shall not escape the floor tonight. Between ourselves, I mean to put you before him before supper is served. Both, Miss Frost, both.
